grade.answer_reason: It gets the core criteria right: 256 KiB is below the 300 KB invoices, so pass a reference instead; the backoff is 2 s doubling to a 10-minute cap, dead-letter after 25 attempts, and retry_limit changes the count but not the curve. But it also states a derived '~3.5 hours' time-to-dead-letter, which the document's numbers don't support (they give about 2.8–2.9 h), so this is an unsupported claim stated as fact.
